title.from: Type SharePayload — Buffer analog (packed post or ad draft; human click only)
title.to: Type Post — Buffer Post (packed copy+media+channel+time; was SharePayload)

description.from:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Type: SharePayload

Buffer analog. A packed post or ad draft: channel, copy, media, destination URL, intended time.

The system **packs**. A human clicks once in a review UI. That click hits the target system or opens the native composer already filled. **That click is the only write to the network.**

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **channel**: `linkedin` | `x` (social); PPC drafts are copy-only (no live ad-account write)
- **copy**
- **media**
- **destination_url**
- **intended_time** (America/New_York)
- **slot** (optional link)
- **campaign** / deliverable

## States

`drafted` → `packed` → `awaiting_human` → `handed_off` | `skipped`

`handed_off` = human clicked. No bot OAuth post required for v1. Posting to LinkedIn / X / Google Ads / Meta may stay out of scope because APIs are hard. Do not auto-post.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> drafted
  drafted --> packed
  packed --> awaiting_human
  awaiting_human --> handed_off
  awaiting_human --> skipped
  handed_off --> [*]
  skipped --> [*]
```

## Out of scope

- No OAuth posting bots
- No Discord channel
- No live ad-account writes
description.to:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. Publicist accepted.

**Renamed from SharePayload.** The SharePayload name is gone. This issue is the Post type. Do not file a second payload type.

## Type: Post

Buffer Post: packed **copy + media + channel + time**. Organic social only. **PPC is AdDraft, not a Post.**

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **channel**: `linkedin` | `x` (not Discord)
- **copy**
- **media** (Creative / Deliverable refs)
- **destination_url** (UTM is a field, not a type)
- **dueAt** lives on the **Slot**, not on LinkedIn’s create call
- **schedulingType** (v1): always `human` / notification — never bot-publish

## LinkedIn constraint

LinkedIn Posts API create is **PUBLISHED only** (no schedule field). We do not send a schedule time to LinkedIn create. `dueAt` stays on our Slot. Native LinkedIn UI clock can Schedule if a human pastes there.

## States

`drafted` → `packed` → `awaiting_human` → `handed_off` | `skipped`

`handed_off` = Ryan/human clicked. That click is the only write to the network. No bot OAuth post required for v1. Do not auto-post.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> drafted
  drafted --> packed
  packed --> awaiting_human
  awaiting_human --> handed_off
  awaiting_human --> skipped
```

## Out of scope

- No OAuth posting bots
- No Discord
- No Google/Meta ad writes (see AdDraft)
- SharePayload is not a type name
